title: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2007

sections.shortTitle: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 2007
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 2007
NATIONAL DATABASE AND
REGISTRATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance further to amend the National Database and Registration
Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 2nd June,
2007]
F. No.2(I)/2007/Pub.,
dated 2-6-2007.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information: ---
Whereas it is expedient to amend the National
Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in session
and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the National Database and Registration Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall be come into force at once.

Whereas it is expedient to amend the National
Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in session
and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:---
2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance VIII of 2000.---(1)
In the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of
2000) hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3,---
(a) in subsection (3),---
(i) after
the word "and" the words "not less than" shall be inserted;
and
(ii) in the proviso, for the
full stop, at the end, a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the
following further proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided further that the Federal Government
may, from time to time, by Notification in the official Gazette, increase or
decrease the number of members and prescribe mode of their appointment as it
may deem fit."; and
(b) in subsection (5), for the words "such
shorter term not exceeding one year", the words "a similar term or
terms" shall be substituted; and
(c) in subsection (8), for
the colon a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso shall be omitted.
